_comment: Single source of truth for the personal-prefs promotion pipeline. Read by src/lib/dev-prefs-mirror.ts + dev-prefs-snapshot.ts (browser / dev route), tools/promote-defaults.mjs, tools/check-prefs-coverage.mjs and tools/sync-defaults.sh (Node), which look rows up by their `id` — never by a restated key or path. Each row's storageKey is PINNED to its runtime owner's exported constant by src/lib/__tests__/dev-prefs-registry-keys-census.test.ts (task 1654). Edit here when adding a promotable pref — never duplicate the list elsewhere.

promotable._comment: Must follow the virgil-editor-prefs entry: bakes the user's global colour transforms into the colour rows it just promoted, computed from the RAW colours in that blob (task 902).

contractSuites._comment: The promotion contract gate (task 1488; tools/sync-defaults.sh runs it). tools/check-prefs-coverage.mjs runs on EVERY promotion; a promoted defaults file listed here ALSO runs its vitest suites. List a suite only when a promoted VALUE can fail it — the promoter already closes each target's vocabulary and value types.
